phase_name: Shared routing library and core-manifest identification

objectives.description: Re-run repo-wide grep for routing_exempt, confirm consumer set
Capture pre-change resolution baseline (280 rows: 140 pairs x 2 efforts)
Refactor command-route-skill.sh to source the library, .name==core identification, routing_trace
Register lib/manifest-routing-lib.sh in core manifest provides.scripts

approaches_tried.approach: routing_lookup echoes the resolved value and sets a side-channel global $_ROUTE_LAST_VIA for the via-tag, caller invokes it via $(routing_lookup ...) command substitution
approaches_tried.reason: command substitution forks a subshell; $_ROUTE_LAST_VIA set inside the subshell never propagates back to the caller, and under set -u the caller's later reference to it is an unbound-variable error that silently kills the sourcing subshell with no output at all
